title_zh: 修订进化课堂海报中的个体与群体说法

scenario.label_zh: 修订进化课堂海报中的个体与群体说法
scenario.goal_zh: 区分个体学习与群体跨世代变化，修改海报中的进化说明及基因示例

context_zh: 学生和生物老师检查课堂海报；这是基础概念交流，不涉及个人健康判断。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: My poster says animals evolve because they try hard to adapt. Is that clear enough?

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: It is clear, but misleading. Evolution describes changes in populations across generations, not an individual deciding to change.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: So a bird learning a new song is not, by itself, an example of evolution?

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: Right. That is a fundamental distinction between learning during one lifetime and inherited changes across generations.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Where should I explain what a gene is?

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: Beside the DNA drawing. Say that a gene is a section of DNA, and use the example we studied in class.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Can I say every genetic difference changes the way an animal looks?

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: No. Some differences have no visible effect. Avoid making the drawing stand for every possible change.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: That fundamentally changes the claim in my first paragraph. I will rewrite it around populations and generations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: Good. Bring the new version tomorrow and we will check that the example matches the explanation.
